meta.note: Keys are raw Chinese string literal content as written in the source (escapes preserved). Values are the English replacement; values may contain ${...} interpolation syntax and are inserted with canonical escaping. Entries may be plain strings, or { "en": "...", "exactOnly": true } for short/generic labels that must only replace a whole literal. See tools/i18n/README.md.
